statement: Find the equation of the tangent to the circle $x^{2}+y^{2}=25$ at the point $(3,4)$.
solution:
The radius to $(3,4)$ has gradient $\tfrac{4}{3}$, so the tangent (being perpendicular) has gradient $-\tfrac34$.
Using point-gradient form:
$$y-4=-\tfrac34(x-3)\quad\Rightarrow\quad 4y-16=-3x+9\quad\Rightarrow\quad 3x+4y=25.$$
(As a check, the distance from the centre $(0,0)$ to this line is $\tfrac{25}{5}=5$, the radius.)
